FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Pedal Power Bicycle Sales & Service, our core operations focus on retail sales and expert bike repairs in a welcoming physical storefront. We offer a comprehensive range of bicycles, accessories, and apparel while ensuring all our staff are thoroughly trained in bicycle mechanics to provide quality service. Our operations are designed to comply with all necessary business licenses and safety regulations, ensuring a safe environment for our customers. To minimize liability exposure, we do not engage in bicycle rental or loaner programs. We maintain strict inventory management systems to safeguard our products and implement security measures including alarm systems and surveillance cameras. Our commitment to customer service is paramount, and we strive to create an engaging shopping experience through knowledgeable staff, organized displays, and community outreach programs.

Our business offers a variety of bicycles for rent, in addition to our sales and service offerings, to provide customers with a complete cycling experience.
